PhoneAPI is listening
The adb listener is running.
PhoneAPI lets a computer connected with USB debugging see this screen, send taps, and control Chrome.
Screen reading and taps
On. The computer can see the screen and send taps.
Starting.
Off. The computer cannot see the screen or send taps.
Off. Plug in a computer and start it from there.
Off. Pair wireless debugging below to turn this on here.
Off. Turn on wireless debugging first.
Wireless debugging
Lets the phone start screen reading without a USB cable, and lets the computer reach Chrome.
On
Off
%1$s. PhoneAPI needs a one-time adb grant to change this. Tap to open Developer options.
Pair wireless debugging
Do this once, so the phone can turn on screen reading without a USB cable.
Paired. The phone can turn on screen reading without a USB cable.
Turn on Developer options first: in Settings, open About phone and tap Build number seven times.

None yet. A computer shows up here after it is granted access.
